Fermionic Toric Code Sign Head

2026-09-03 · morning reportbranch feat/fermionic-3d-signheadvenue L=2 OBC (12 qubits, dense ED) + 2×2×3 OBC (20 qubits)

The 3D fermionic toric code's sign structure is a lattice cup product, and a decoded, perturbation-theory-weighted sign head framed into the Hamiltonian makes the NQS exact to machine precision against ED wherever the head is exact. The plane and hy campaigns are still running; everything below is measured.

1. The sign is a cup product

At h=0 the ground state is the projector state on the orbit of |all up〉 under stars and decorated-plaquette pair moves. Writing the flipped-edge pattern of a configuration as a 1-cochain b, its flux F=δb, and lifting b along the body-diagonal (1,1,1) lines to a cochain a with (1+S)a=b, the sign is

s(σ) = ∫ a ∪ δa = Σp (δa)p · a(e+(p)) (mod 2), ψ0(σ) ∝ (−1)s(σ)

Geometrically: the mod-2 self-linking number of the flux loops with the framing set by the decoration's body diagonal. The polarization of this quadratic form is the mod-2 linking form of flux loops, so s is a quadratic refinement of the linking form (an Arf/Brown–Kervaire structure), the spatial analogue of the Steenrod-square term in Chen–Kapustin's 3D bosonization.

  • Exact at every size tested: PBC L=2,3,4,5,6 and OBC 2³, 3³, 4³, 5³, 2×2×3, 2×3×4, 3000/3000 random orbit states each, star-gauge invariant. At OBC the boundary is the seam; a star-gauge fix that zeroes the diagonal-line parities is required first.
  • The range-1 form "count flux plaquettes whose diagonal partner edge is flipped" is exact only at L=3 (an accident: the translation-invariant lift exists iff L is odd, and at L=3 it is a pure translation). Even L needs the seam, which is the spin-structure choice; this is the old "TI stencil iff L odd" theorem explained.
  • Off-support structure: a single σx flip lights exactly one detector, the (1,1,1)-diagonal line of edges containing it (3L² lines on a torus; 12→8 and 27→16 independent after the star quotient at L=2,3). Recovery is one flip per lit line with an intrinsic L-fold tie about which edge, so the decoder is a tie-break rule, not a matching problem.

Library: tc3d/sign_geometry.py (CupSign, 0.2 s per 20k configs at L=3 OBC). Notes: notes/fermionic_sign_geometry.md, notes/fermionic_sign_geometry_numerics.md.

2. Gate 0: sign-fidelity ceilings against ED

Fs = |ψED|²-weighted agreement of a deterministic ±1 head with the exact sign (anchored gauge ψ(all up) > 0), the fidelity ceiling of any positive trunk times that head. Heads: anaC (frozen analytic form + solver-gauge shadow), linear (fixed GF(2) recovery), vote (majority of the on-support form over the tied minimal recoveries = first-order perturbation theory), pt2 (second-order tie-break), plus (sign-blind).

  • The linear head reproduces the old 0.992455 ceiling at (0.2,0) bit-for-bit. The 2D peer's theorem explains it: any GF(2)-linear decoder mis-decodes at least dim ker(check) single-flip channels.
  • At 2×2×3 OBC, hx=0.2: anaC 1.5e-2, linear 7.9e-3, vote 1.2e-4, pt2 3.3e-7 (24 000× over linear). Small-hx exponents: anaC ~hx2.2, linear ~hx2.3, vote ~hx4.4, pt2 ~hx9.9. pt2 resolves 100% of vote ties.
  • At L=2 OBC, vote and pt2 are exact on the full 4096-dim space up to hx=0.5. All frozen heads share the on-support h=0 form and saturate for hx ≳ 0.6, where the sign-blind head crosses below them: the sign structure itself goes from topological to trivial as the state polarizes.

42 runs at L=2 OBC, hx ∈ {0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0}, 300 SR steps, exact evaluation against dense ED every 25 steps. The new arms train a positive real trunk on the sign-framed Hamiltonian H̃ = S H S (formulation B from the 2D peer); the network and sampler are untouched.

  • Machine-exact where the head is exact and hz=0: at (0.2, 0) and (0.5, 0) both framed arms reach 1−F of 3e-13 to 5e-12 and relative energy error 1e-9 to 1e-10. The complex trunk neither helps nor hurts there, so at hy=0 the trunk does not need to be complex.
  • Off the hz=0 row the framed arms are optimization-limited, not sign-limited. At hz ∈ {0.2, 0.5, 1.0} with hx ∈ {0.2, 0.5} gate 0 says the pt2 head is exact (or 6.5e-5 and 4.8e-4 on the hz=1 row), yet the trained infidelity is 7e-5 to 5e-3 and the energy error 3e-5 to 2e-3. That is the same 1e-5 to 1e-4 floor the electric column (hx=0) shows for every head-aware arm: with a diagonal field on, the amplitude landscape is what 300 cold SR steps do not finish. It is still two to three orders better than the sign-blind trunk at the same points.
  • The hx=1 column is where the heads are wrong (gate-0 ceiling 7e-2), and the complex trunk does not repair it: 1−F = 0.38 (complex) vs 0.17 (real) at (1, 0), 0.08–0.14 elsewhere in the column, while the sign-blind trunk sits at 1e-4 to 1e-15 there. The frozen head's run at (1, 0.2) was guard-terminated (1−F = 0.96) and should be read as a failed run, not a measurement. Once the state polarizes, the topological sign prior is the wrong prior and no trunk of this size recovers from it within the budget.

5. hy ≠ 0 and the complex trunk

Ready and queued. The dense ED referee now includes −hyΣσy (gates: Hermiticity, ±hy pair to 5e-15, Hellmann–Feynman to 7e-10). The phase-optimized ceiling of a ±1 head against a complex ground state (the peer's definition) gives, at hy=0.2: pt2 0.993 at (0.2, 0.2) vs anaC 0.982 and plus 0.738, and the head class saturates near 0.99, so the complex trunk must carry the residual phases. The framed run at (0.2, 0.2) builds a complex trunk with genuinely nonzero Im〈E〉 during training, as expected for a complex H̃. A real trunk is refused at hy≠0 by construction. Job 57868774 runs the same 4×4 grid at hy=0.2 with three arms (sign-blind complex, frozen head + complex trunk, pt2 frame + complex trunk).

6. Wiring, audit, and what is left

  • tc3d/sign_frame.py: SignFramedOperator (mels × s(x)s(x′)), heads anaC / table / cup, --sign_frame and --dtype complex in train.py. A/B witness against the in-network frozen head: identical signs on 256 configs, local energies to 4e-15.
  • Adversarial audit found the operator sound and the downstream stack wrong for framed runs; all fixed: exact eval now signs ψ = S·A (ideal trunk at h=0: −8 → −14, fidelity 0.0625 → 1.0), MC mean-ops framed at all four call sites, ψ-level S2/OFM estimators refuse framed checkpoints, --init_from refuses silent complex→real promotion, host-side head cost guarded (Np ≤ 64, table N ≤ 24).
  • Scaling path beyond ED sizes: the on-support cup head is parameter-free at any L; the off-support recovery needs an on-the-fly pt2 evaluator (currently a 2N table).
  • Next after the plane and hy jobs: regenerate figures, finalize the BLOG entry (draft ready), open the PR.
